question.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>56</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi></math> of nitrogen gas is mixed with excess of hydrogen gas and it is found that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi></math> of ammonia gas is produced, The volume of unused nitrogen gas is found to be_____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi></math>.

solution.text: Gay-Lussac's Law proposes a relationship between the combining volumes of gases with respect to the reactants and gaseous products. According to this law, when gases react together to produce gaseous products, the volumes of reactants and products bear a simple whole number ratio with each other, provided volumes are measured at same temperature and pressure.
